modern: The gods, who are immortal, are not annoyed because for so long a time they must continually put up with men such as they are, and so many of them bad; and besides this, they also take care of them in every way. But you, who are destined to end so soon, are you tired of enduring the bad, and this too when you are one of them?
original: The gods who are immortal are not vexed because during so long a time they must tolerate continually men such as they are and so many of them bad; and besides this, they also take care of them in all ways. But thou, who art destined to end so soon, art thou wearied of enduring the bad, and this too when thou art one of them?
